name: personal-code-workbench
description: 个人代码活动工作台，与公司仓库分离，整目录可带走

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.tunnel:web: npm run build --prefix web && npm run preview --prefix web
scripts.tunnel: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run tunnel:web"
